title: GitPress site configuration (gitpress.json)
description: Lives at the root of a GitPress data repository. schemaVersion is bumped only for breaking changes; new fields are always additive and optional.

schemaVersion.description: Spec version of this file. Builders must refuse versions they do not understand instead of guessing.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag, e.g. en, zh-CN.

url.description: Canonical site URL, e.g. https://alice.github.io/my-blog. Used for sitemap/RSS/absolute links.

basePath.description: Path prefix the site is served under (GitHub Pages project sites use /<repo>/).

source.description: Where to fetch the theme. Formats: 'builtin' (resolved from the official GitPress themes monorepo), 'github:<owner>/<repo>[/<subdir>]#<ref>', or 'npm:<package>@<version>'.

ref.description: Pinned version/tag/commit of the theme. Builders must never float to latest implicitly.

config.description: Theme-specific options, validated against the theme's theme.json configSchema.

includeDrafts.description: Safety valve for previews. Public builds must keep this false.

output.description: Build output directory inside the theme project.

plugins.description: Reserved for the GitPress plugin system (spec v1 does not execute plugins; builders must ignore unknown entries without failing).
